technique_name: Design an automated chatbot to help customers with product related queries
description: The chatbot would be designed to understand customers' questions and provide answers based on their queries. It will use natural language processing (NLP) and machine learning (ML) algorithms to process inputs, understand contextual cues, and generate meaningful responses. It will be trained on a wide range of customer service questions and follow a decision tree based logic to answer the most common questions.
